name: Glooko
author: jakejayeden
description: Displays the latest glucose, IOB and Omnipod mode available from Glooko, with freshness information and glucose history.
release_notes: Adds selectable 3/6/12/24-hour graph history, integrates the Colourise graph setting into the installable schema, fixes trend-arrow placement, and documents GitHub/Web UI deployment and one-time Pi prerequisites.
